Type: wooden storage bin
Use: storing blankets, magazines or plants; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: whitewashed distressed wood, galvanized metal lining, jute rope handles
Colors: white washed, warm natural wood, grey metal
Shape: square tapered box wider at top, rough plank texture, rope loop handles, medium and solid
Feel: rustic, warm, homey
Goes with: reclaimed wood, white shiplap, galvanized and black metal; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Modern Farmhouse Wood and Galvanized Metal Decor Storage Bin Basket, 14 Inch, White Washed (Renewed)
product.description: This clean, crisp storage bin will boost your style while concealing clutter or storing treasured items.  With white-washed wood on the outside, galvanized metal on the inside and hemp ropes for handles, this piece will blend with most any décor. 14"D x 14"W x 10"H This bin looks attractive on a shelf, or out in full view as a catch-all for clutter Fir wood, engineered wood, galvanized metal, hemp rope For indoor use
